capabilities: bounded host health and VM state summary
paged VM inventory and exact VM detail
mandatory_guards: no arbitrary PowerShell, WMI, CIM, WinRM or event-log surface
no VM, checkpoint, disk, switch, replication or cluster state mutation
dedicated constrained JEA endpoint required by production default
unrestricted PowerShell endpoints rejected when JEA is required
query budgets for requests, items, bytes, fan-out and elapsed time
connector page, rate, concurrency and response-size limits
fixed event log IDs and bounded lookback
actor, reason and correlation ID in structured audit envelope
deployment_boundary: Public code contains no company hostnames, IPs, credentials or topology. Logical target aliases and authorization are deployment-owned.

writes.future_policy: Any concrete write workflow must use a separate least-privilege identity and plan/approval/change/verify with idempotency, pre-state and rollback where possible.
